This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is fourth bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 27.8.2021 in connection with Crime No.264/2021, registered at Police Station Badera District Satna for the offence punishable under Sections 376 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
2. Counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 27.8.2021.
He is a young man of aged about 20 years.

It is further submitted that material witness in the case i.e. prosecutrix has Shailendra @ Golu Choudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81340578/
1 already been examined in the Court.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is no chance to influence the witness or tamper with the evidence.
Considering the period of custody and young age of the applicant, he may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the application and submitted prosecutrix is minor and offence committed by the applicant is serious in nature.
In these circumstances, he may not be released on bail.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

5. Considering the fact that applicant is a young man of 20 years of age and material witness in the case has already been examined, and there is no chance to influence the witness or tamper with the evidence, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for her appearance before the trial Court on the dates fixed by that Court as and when directed.

7. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE DUBEY/-
